name: WORKDAY
description: WORKDAY returns the date that is a given number of working days before or after a start date, skipping Saturdays and Sundays and optionally a list of holidays.
tldr: Returns a date n workdays from a start date.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The number of workdays to move. Positive moves forward, negative moves backward. The start date itself is not counted.

parameters.name: holidays
parameters.description: Optional range or array of dates to exclude as non-working days.

basicExample.explanation: Starting Monday Jan 1, 10 workdays (skipping Sat/Sun) land on Monday Jan 15 2024 (serial 45305).

advancedExamples.title: Excluding a holiday
advancedExamples.scenario: A project deadline with a mid-period holiday
advancedExamples.description: The holiday pushes the result one day later
advancedExamples.explanation: Without the holiday the 10th workday is Jan 15, but excluding Jan 15 (a Monday) shifts the result to Jan 16 (serial 45306).

advancedExamples.title: Moving backward
advancedExamples.description: A negative days value goes to the past
advancedExamples.explanation: Ten workdays earlier is Monday Jan 1 2024 (serial 45291).

howItWorks: WORKDAY walks forward (or backward) from start_date, counting only weekdays (Monday-Friday by default) and skipping any date listed in holidays, until it has counted the requested number of workdays. The start date is not included in the count.

howToSteps.name: Enter the start date
howToSteps.text: Provide a date serial or DATE(...) expression.

howToSteps.name: Enter the number of workdays
howToSteps.text: Use a positive or negative integer.

howToSteps.name: Optionally list holidays
howToSteps.text: Pass a range or array of holiday dates to exclude.

limitations: Only Saturday and Sunday weekends are supported; use WORKDAY.INTL for custom weekend days.
The start date itself is not counted toward the days total.
Holidays must be valid date serials, not text.

commonErrors.cause: A non-date start_date or a holiday that Excel cannot read as a date.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure all date arguments are real date serials.
Apply a date number format to the result.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: WORKDAY works identically in Google Sheets, including the optional holidays argument.

faq.question: Does WORKDAY count the start date?
faq.answer: No, the start date is excluded; it counts only the workdays after it.

faq.question: How do I use a custom weekend?
faq.answer: Use WORKDAY.INTL, which accepts a weekend code or 7-character weekend string.

faq.question: Can days be negative?
faq.answer: Yes, a negative value returns a date before the start date.
